messages:
Alex K: FYI — opened docs PR #4512 to standardize SOC2-friendly phrasing around audit logs & retention. Legal flagged two items: (1) the word 'indefinite' in the export section, (2) our sample curl/Go snippets include raw timestamps + user identifiers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4512 Please @Priya (legal) and @Maria R for snippet sanity. Thinking we should add a short migration note about the TTL change for hosted exports.

docs-bot: PR 4512 CI: docs build passed, staging preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-4512 :white_check_mark:

Priya (legal): thanks — will take a look. Prefer the phrasing 'retention period' and avoid 'indefinite' unless customer explicitly opts in. Also we should make audit export examples redact principal identifiers by default (email/phone).

Maria R: I can tackle the snippets. Do we prefer showing a pseudonymized example like user_id: 'anon-123' or demonstrate a redaction helper function? Lean toward both: a tiny pseudonymized snippet for readability + a link to a short redaction util code block.

Jordan L: Quick ops note — we changed export timestamp format earlier from epoch-ms to RFC3339 which breaks naive parsers. Can we add a migration snippet for both Go and JS? e.g.
```js
// JS parse RFC3339
const t = new Date('2024-05-01T12:34:56Z');
```
and
```go
// Go parse RFC3339
import "time"
t, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, ts)
```
This will save customers a lot of support noise.

Alex K: OK sounds good. Priya, would this root paragraph work? 'Customers may configure retention; by default audit exports redact direct identifiers. For regulatory needs, contact support for extended retention options.'

Priya (legal): mostly yes but replace 'direct identifiers' with 'personal identifiers (e.g., email, phone)' to be explicit. Also add: 'Customers must ensure exported logs are stored in accordance with applicable laws and their internal policies.'

Maria R: I'll push a small commit with a pseudonymized snippet + Go/JS parse examples + updated phrasing. I'll also add a short migration note under /guides/migration/audit-exports.md and fix the anchor link in the index. @Alex K please do a quick pass after I push.

Alex K: thanks. Small checklist before merge: 1) update docs index anchor (link fix), 2) confirm SDK snippet paths in the examples folder, 3) add a comment about default redaction in the export CLI, 4) optional: unit test for snippet generation in docs build. Ping when ready and I'll merge. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: new commit pushed: 3a7f1b — preview updated: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-4512 :rocket:
